Chapter 1243: 5 Da Fu Ancestor (Request For Subscription)_2

Chapter 1243: Chapter 5 Da Fu Ancestor (Request for Subscription)_2

If there were no Chaos Void Origin Infusion gifts, the inner cosmos would find it difficult to become widespread in the Chaos Void, as most powerful beings cannot sustain the consumption of operating the inner cosmos.

However, in this Fang Yuan World, there are no Origin Infusion gifts, but there are six ancestral lineages offering support, causing almost every living being to have ancestral bloodline flowing within them.

The ancestral bloodline, at the thirteenth level, is terrifyingly powerful once its potential is excavated, even if it is thin.

Therefore, the cutting-in point of the Martial Arts Evolution Road in this Fang Yuan World is to fully excavate the ancestral bloodline.

“Bloodline…”

Lin Yuan looked at his palm while observing a drop of Dragon Abyss Blood, comprehending the most fundamental power deep within the bloodline.

Clatter.

Suddenly, the Dragon Abyss Blood suspended in front of Lin Yuan boiled, abruptly transforming into a small black dragon the size of a palm.

Every scale on the black dragon seemed like an endless abyss, and the imperceptible aura started to affect the surrounding space-time silently.

“Is this the initial creature ‘Abyss Dragon’?” Lin Yuan carefully observed, using the excavation of the fundamental power in the bloodline to reshape the original form of the ‘Abyss Dragon’ with a drop of blood.

Of course, it was only the form; as for consciousness and mind, they were long obliterated, but even so, Lin Yuan could sense the terror of the ‘Abyss Dragon’.

“Just a dragon formed from a drop of fresh blood has such an imposing force; the full strength of this initial creature in its prime was indeed not weaker than I am now,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun also mentioned this initial creature, although referred to as a ‘negative example’, but it depends on comparison; the Da Fu Ancestor personally killed the ‘Abyss Dragon’, proving the terror of this initial creature.

It must be known that for time-time creatures, anything under the thirteenth tier would not catch their eyes at all.

“It is almost complete.”

With a wave of his hand, Lin Yuan caused the palm-sized black dragon to dissipate instantly, transforming back into a drop of Dragon Abyss Blood, which was promptly put away by him.

After several centuries of perfection, Lin Yuan thoroughly shaped the branch of the Martial Arts Evolution Road to be fully adapted to this Fang Yuan World, and to the Six Ancient Countries.

“But wanting to spread the branch of the Martial Arts Evolution Road still requires informing the Ancestor.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, “All life in the Fierce Sun Ancient Country are descendants of the Ancestor, using the cultivation system handed down by the Ancestor.”

Lin Yuan wanted to spread the branch of the Martial Arts Evolution Road here, even if it was only supplementary practice, he still had to inform the Ancestor of Fierce Sun.

With this in mind, Lin Yuan whispered the words ‘Fierce Sun’.

Invisible power converged, forming the figure of the Ancestor of Fierce Sun, who looked at Lin Yuan with a smile: “Galaxy.”

“Ancestor, may I spread the path of my evolution branch…” Lin Yuan said.

“Spread the path of your evolution branch?” the Ancestor of Fierce Sun looked at Lin Yuan with a grin and nodded, saying: “Of course you can.”

“Thank you, Ancestor.” Lin Yuan said.

“There’s no need for thanks between us.”

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun shook his head, his figure disappearing.

…

The Da Fu Ancient Country occupied the richest area of this heaven and earth, with the imperial palace at the very center of the capital, wherein many figures were gathered deep within at this moment.

These figures exuded powerful auras, at least being top Peak Venerables, with nearly ten of the Strongest Venerables standing among them.

“The Ancestor is about to arrive, and as per usual practices, will guide our cultivation.” The emperor of the Da Fu Ancient Country said in a heavy voice: “And will also be informed about recent events.”

Among the ancestors of the six ancient countries, the Da Fu Ancestor was most dedicated to nurturing progeny and descendants, descending every once in a while to guide the top Peak Venerables and the Strongest Peak Venerables.

This was originally an unparalleled great opportunity for the strong of the Da Fu Ancient Country, obtaining guidance from the Ancestor without any merit required?

However, now.

Numerous Da Fu Venerables on the scene felt immense pressure.

Because amongst the many recent events, the Fierce Sun Ancient Country defeated the Da Fu Ancient Country, seizing the newly emerged top-grade treasured land, which absolutely could not be hidden from the Ancestor.

Though it was said, the Da Fu Ancient Country’s failure to seize the Golden Mist Treasury was entirely because of Galaxy Venerate’s overwhelmingly terrifying power, a non-combat-related fault, but the Da Fu Ancestor wouldn’t care about these, only viewing the Venerables on the scene as useless.

In terms of power, among the six ancestors, the Da Fu Ancestor was the oldest and also the strongest, and the Da Fu Ancient Country was the most powerful ancient country, with everything related to the Da Fu Ancestor being the strongest.

But now?

This fact was broken by Galaxy Venerate.

If the difference wasn’t large, the many Da Fu Venerables on the scene still had the confidence to reclaim honor.

But with the power Galaxy Venerate displayed in the Treasury, even the strongest Venerables of the Da Fu Ancient Country dared not attempt reclaiming the field.

The difference was too great.

So great that there was no opportunity to catch up.

Now the Venerables of the Da Fu Ancient Country only hoped Galaxy Venerate would quickly advance to that next step.

That way, whether success or failure, they wouldn’t have to bear the pressure Lin Yuan brought.

“The Ancestor is about to descend.”

The emperor of the Da Fu Ancient Country glanced at the many Venerables on the scene, feeling unsure inside. The ancestors were high above, contending in the open and secret, and now that the Da Fu Ancient Country was weaker than the Fierce Sun Ancient Country by more than a margin, how could the Ancestor be happy if they knew?

If the Ancestor wasn’t happy, these progeny descendants would suffer.

…

Fierce Sun Capital.

After obtaining the Ancestor’s consent, Lin Yuan immediately approached the Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

Spreading the branch of the Martial Arts Evolution Road was a trivial matter, Lin Yuan certainly wouldn’t do it himself; it had to be handed over to the Ancient Country.

“Galaxy.” The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country looked at Lin Yuan, speaking in a gentle tone: “What brings you to me?”

“I have perfected the method to excavate ancestral bloodlines.” Lin Yuan said.

“Oh?” The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s eyes lit up.

If, before, he merely held expectations for the Venerate’s level of ancestral bloodline,

after witnessing the event of competing for the treasury, observing Galaxy Venerate’s overwhelming strength,

the Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country was not just expectant but fervent.

Of course, the Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country also understood that many of the techniques Lin Yuan displayed in the treasury were largely due to the powerful path of Chaos Evolution, but the contribution of the ancestral bloodline’s support could not be overlooked.

Especially the creation of an entirely new Fierce Sun World centered around his Fierce Sun was unbelievably powerful.

“However, the excavation of bloodlines is very random, and not everyone could dig out the powerful talents within the ancestral bloodline.” Lin Yuan reminded.

After integrating into this Fang Yuan World, the branch of the Martial Arts Evolution Road saw significant progress in excavating inner bloodlines, but regardless of the progress, it depended on each individual.

As the Ancestor of Martial Arts and possessor of Against-Heaven’s Understanding, Lin Yuan could grasp bloodline’s fundamental power at a deeper level, thus awakening the ‘Fierce Sun Opens the Heavens’ Divine Skill.

However, other cultivators didn’t have Lin Yuan’s methods, and the excavation of bloodline abilities depended not only on oneself but also on the strength of the bloodline’s power at its deepest core.

The key element was that Lin Yuan’s method was a fusion of inner cosmos, the Divine Ability ‘World’, ‘Infinite Void’ inheritance, and ‘Fierce Sun Opens the Heavens’.

A purely Fierce Sun Opens the Heavens Divine Skill was certainly powerful, but it had many constraints.

“Naturally.”

The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country nodded, unsurprised.

The same cultivation inheritance, some beings could step into the Great Lord, while others found it hard even entering the Path Splitting Realm.

If Lin Yuan’s perfected method for excavating ancestral bloodlines allowed every being to tap into bloodline talents at the Venerate level, the Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country would indeed find it unbelievable.

For the Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, even slightly increasing the amount of ancestral bloodline power excavated from the beings of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, and slightly enhancing the overall, was already very satisfying.

As the bloodline power excavated by lower-tier beings increased a bit, the number of middle-tier strong beings rose, and the number of upper-tier strong beings rose in succession, thereby enhancing the overall national strength of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

“Please, take a look.”

With a wave of his right hand, Lin Yuan displayed the improved branch of the Martial Arts Evolution Road swiftly in front of him.

From the first layer to the eleventh layer, and the various branches after the twelfth layer, Lin Yuan organized them very thoroughly.

The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country immediately began to carefully examine them.

“What is this?”

The more the Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country looked, the more shocked he became.
